steps.name: asgi-adapter-contract-foundation
steps.summary: Added standard-library ASGI adapter foundation with public ASGI boundary exports, HttpRouter-backed request/response conversion, bounded body collection, router error serialization, and unsupported lifespan/websocket handling without new framework dependencies.

steps.name: fastapi-thin-adapter
steps.summary: Added optional FastAPI thin adapter with lazy availability contract, route manifest-preserving HttpRouter dispatch, public API exports, docs, and forbidden-import coverage.

steps.name: fastapi-runtime-public-contracts
steps.summary: Added ASGI/FastAPI runtime preview public contract coverage in scripts/test_fastapi_asgi_public_contracts.py, no-server-start adapter metadata, and README scope/verification docs.
